title: Adaptive Reliability Reserves for Residential Battery Fleets
abstract: arXiv:2611.34779v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In a Houston 2024 replay, replacing a fixed 20 percent battery reserve with a county-risk threshold raises observed five-hour backup coverage from 75.0 percent to 86.5 percent and adds USD 10.2 in modeled annualized margin per home (paired 95 percent interval: USD +1.7 to USD +21.7). The paired coverage-gain interval includes zero. This is a conditional simulation result, not measured company reliability. Residential batteries face this tradeoff because market discharge consumes energy also needed for household outages. We release HomeFleet-ERCOT, combining observed prices and county outages with identified simulated homes and causal controller inputs. We compare independent-home optimization with 21 proximal policy optimization (PPO) training runs; ten promise-cost candidates span 31.1 percent-96.3 percent backup coverage. translated_title: 面向住宅电池集群的自适应可靠性备用容量
translated_abstract: 在2024年休斯顿重放模拟中，用县级风险阈值替代固定的20%电池备用容量，可将观测到的五小时备用覆盖率从75.0%提升至86.5%，并在模型中为每户增加10.2美元的年化收益（配对95%置信区间：+1.7至+21.7美元）。配对的覆盖率增益区间包含零。这是条件模拟结果，而非实测的公司可靠性指标。住宅电池之所以面临这一权衡，是因为市场放电会消耗原本需要留给家庭停电期间使用的能量。我们发布了HomeFleet-ERCOT数据集，将观测到的电价和县级停电数据与经过辨识的模拟住宅及因果控制器输入相结合。我们比较了独立住宅优化与21次近端策略优化（PPO）训练运行；十个承诺成本候选方案的备用覆盖率介于31.1%至96.3%之间。其中，10个方案的模式化收益低于固定20%备用容量的方案，另有3个方案的覆盖率也更低。（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出用县级风险阈值取代固定20%电池备用容量的自适应策略，在休斯顿2024年重放模拟中将五小时备用覆盖率从75.0%提升至86.5%并带来每户约10.2美元的年化模型收益，同时发布了结合真实电价、县级停电数据与模拟住宅的HomeFleet-ERCOT数据集，并对比了独立优化与PPO强化学习训练的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes replacing a fixed 20% battery reserve with an adaptive county-risk threshold, raising five-hour backup coverage from 75.0% to 86.5% in a Houston 2024 replay simulation, and releases the HomeFleet-ERCOT dataset combining observed prices, county outages, and simulated homes to benchmark independent optimization against PPO reinforcement learning.
